_comment: riverfarm_fight's start. warrior5+mage5 (the harness-tuned 'warrior5_mage5' build, matching door_chain_fight_start's shape). `hunter_will_come` is NOT pre-banked here -- the script earns it LIVE (the come-along beat at the village hunter, before TRAVEL) so all three live fights field riverfarm_hunter as an ally (briar_collectors/briar_collectors_deep/river_wolf_pack all ship allies:[riverfarm_hunter]/ally_requires:{hunter_will_come:1}, matching sim_combat_batch.gd's own gated/measured _hunter cells rather than the much harder _solo siblings; NOT Relc -- Riverfarm is a solo Door arrival with no fictional basis for the Liscor Watch, see combatants.json's riverfarm_hunter _comment). met_relc/sparred_with_relc/given_spear_by_relc stay banked as genuine unrelated tutorial-arc history (harmless, no longer read by any Riverfarm gate). riverfarm_attuned pre-banked (the door-chain arrival is R1's own proof, not this script's). Standing at (11,10) facing up, directly south of riverfarm_headman (11,9) -- first interact plays his talk_pool line, second opens riverfarm_headman. heard_price_of_a_favor is NOT banked and the quest is NOT started -- the script proves the full give -> ask the hunter along -> travel -> clear both waves -> report -> completion loop honestly. rng_state was originally the hand-typed raw int '1' -- the repo-wide landmine (issue #45): WISave restores .state directly, not .seed, so a small hand-typed int collapses the first randi() draw to the same degenerate output regardless of which small int is picked (the #38 method exists because of exactly this). Re-derived: seeded a fresh RandomNumberGenerator with .seed=1, captured the resulting .state (-1966449618399012673), installed it, and re-ran riverfarm_fight end-to-end -- passed on the FIRST candidate (all three live fights, briar_collectors/briar_collectors_deep/river_wolf_pack, still land victories with riverfarm_hunter allied). If a future roster/data change ever flips one of the three, re-search by seeding candidate N=1,2,3... through the same derive-then-verify loop (script: a throwaway `RandomNumberGenerator; .seed=N; print(.state)` run, patch this field, re-run riverfarm_fight) until all three land victories at one shared starting state.
